title: Arrests Over France Protests Rise to 1,800; Whole Streets in Paris 'Devastated'
detail: The Guardian's live coverage on 18 October reports arrests linked to the nationwide protests have risen to 1,800, with whole streets in Paris described as devastated.

title: Macron to address nation after deadly protests
detail: Al Jazeera's live coverage on 18 October reports President Emmanuel Macron is set to address the nation following deadly protests across France.

media.caption: France protests live: Macron to address nation after deadly protests
